name: v196_gross_guidance_wdpq_tax
hypothesis: Gross-income guidance improvement plus low WDPQ event magnitude and low deferred-tax valuation allowance should capture cleaner forward operating delivery without using sales-option, EPS, FCF/contract, current-liability, or news-chain sleeves.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_maxguidance) / (2 * sales), 63), 126), industry) + 0.28 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_wdpq)), 126), industry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * deferred_tax_assets_valuation_allowance_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Side-channel fusion; strict-check against omKoPEb6, pw6jz8ob, QPaze5zX, and all v192-v195 actives.

name: v196_sh_equity_guidance_prepaid_tax
hypothesis: Shareholder-equity guidance improvement with low prepaid expenses and low deferred-tax valuation allowance tests a balance-sheet cleanliness route distinct from EPS/value and current-liability families.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sh_equity_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 63), 126), subindustry) + 0.28 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * prepaid_expense_total_2 / assets, 126), industry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * deferred_tax_assets_valuation_allowance_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Avoids EPS and buyback/share-count repair sleeves; reject if it maps to pw6jz8ob or O0p8JGJq.

name: v196_wdpq_fscore_netdebt
hypothesis: Low WDPQ event magnitude, favorable f-score value/curvature, and lower net-debt expectations may form a non-option, non-news-chain accounting stability signal.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.32 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_wdpq)), 126), industry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fscore_surface_accel, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_value, 126), industry) + 0.16 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_detail_estimate_1qf_v4_nd_netdebt_mean / assets, 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Tests WDPQ without PCR/option sleeve, after v194 showed WDPQ+PCR is LSUS fragile.

name: v196_gross_guidance_fscore_lowrisk
hypothesis: Gross-income guidance improvement, f-score value, and low market risk create a slower operating-improvement signal that should be less related to npgrXA3q sales-option and v193 FCF/contract.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.38 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_grossincome_maxguidance) / (2 * sales), 63), 126), industry) + 0.26 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_value, 126), industry) + 0.22 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fscore_surface_accel, 126), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
